cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A copies an apparent privacy cue and masks the mistake while offering personal jealousy as bait for B hidden motive.
confusable: D136 exchanges own truths for motive; D126 tests factual consistency without that bait.
seedUse: Preserve escalating self-disclosure and B distinction between loneliness and preference.
